diagram.title: Mapped rows and shared weights
diagram.prediction: What should happen if you duplicate an input row while keeping the same shared weights?
diagram.reading: Each row enters the same single-example rule with one shared weight vector. The scalar results are stacked in row order. This is a mathematical mapping, not a hardware-thread allocation. Reordering observations should reorder outputs identically.
